findings.mechanism: Correlation identifiers are generated per service rather than propagated; logs lack a request‑level ID, preventing a single query to retrieve all log lines for a request.
findings.remediation: Add propagation of a correlation ID (e.g., X-Request-ID) from inbound requests, include it in all log statements and outbound headers, and ensure downstream services forward it.
findings.arithmetic: No request ID is added to logs; on‑call cannot correlate logs across services, making diagnosis impossible.
